content:
Context: 5. Final payment of accumulations in PF

If no nomination subsists or same relates to part of the amount - payable to members of family in equal shares leaving out any part covered by the nomination. Sons who have attained majority, sons of a deceased son who have attained majority, married daughters whose husbands are alive, and married daughters of a deceased son, whose husbands are alive, will not be eligible, if there is any member of the family other than those four categories.  
- to the nominee(s) in
